devex-sara: Quick proposal — add a structured 'fallback_priority' header in SDKs so callers can opt routing preference order (e.g. ['dedicated','private','hosted']). This influences server-side routing fallback. It's a small API shape change but could be breaking for older clients. Thoughts?

plat-kim: Do we have an agreed header name? We currently use x-rd-route in places. New name might be x-rd-fallback-priority or extend existing. Back-compat concerns.

eng-jordan: This will affect console metrics attribution and our quota dashboards. We need to emit telemetry that records which fallback chain was attempted & final route chosen. Otherwise rollouts will be opaque.

pm-ryan: From product side — migration UX should be graceful. Default behavior must be unchanged if SDKs don't send the header. Also need a migration banner in Console for 1) customers who pin routes and 2) those on Dedicated.

devex-sara: Proposal: 1) add header x-rd-fallback-priority as JSON array string, 2) server ignores unknown values (so older servers are safe), 3) SDKs will ship behind opt-in feature flag first, 4) add deprecation warnings in SDK logs when legacy enum used.

eng-jordan: Can we also add a lightweight telemetry field: routing.fallback_chain_attempts (sampled) — otherwise dashboards will not show how many requests hit fallback vs primary. Sampling fine — don't want cardinality explosion.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy with routing-fallback branch scheduled at 1718001150 — tests include header-parsing unit tests and basic telemetry event emit.

plat-kim: Edge case: what if header lists only unavailable routes and server falls back to a region with different cost SLA? We need a server-side safety policy (max cost/budget override) and a clear signal back to caller.

devex-sara: Agreed. Server will validate the list and apply policy gates; if none are usable, response includes x-rd-final-route and x-rd-fallback-reason headers. SDKs should surface these via warnings.

ts-maintainer-lee: I'll take the TS client PR. Schema question: do we send JSON (e.g. '["dedicated","hosted"]') or a comma list? JSON is nicer for future fields (weights).

py-maintainer-ana: For Python we prefer JSON too. Semver question: is this a patch or minor? If servers ignore missing header, it's additive — should be a minor bump. But if we change default behavior, that needs a major.

go-maintainer-oli: Go client can do a patch if we keep defaults. We'll add helper types to parse/validate.

devex-sara: Final call: use header name x-rd-fallback-priority with JSON array string. SDKs ship as minor releases with opt-in flag and opt-out by default. Deprecation window: 12 weeks for legacy enum telemetry, 3 months general signal. eng-team -> please add sampling telemetry (eng-jordan) and console tile (pm-ryan). I'll open umbrella PRs for TS/Py/Go.

plat-kim: ack

eng-jordan: adding TTL on telemetry events so we can purge high-cardinality traces after rollout.

py-maintainer-ana: I'll queue the py PR for next sprint; will add a migration note in changelog and runtime warning when flag is true.

ts-maintainer-lee: Starting TS PR today, will include examples for pinned-routes UX.

devex-sara: Thanks all — I'll track owners in the rollout doc and post update once staging deploy passes integration tests. :thumbsup:
